chunks: Whatever is in it from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Kathīr al-Hāshimī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥassān al-Wāsiṭī, from his uncle ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Kathīr al-Hāshimī.

key_terms.الْوَاسِطِيِّ: A relational descriptor indicating association with Wāsiṭ.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: An honorific supplication meaning: may Allah be pleased with him.
key_terms.عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ الْهَاشِ: A narrator from whom reports are transmitted in this chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Kathīr al-Hāshimī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Kathīr al-Hāshimī. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and that narrator.
